binding_constraint.why_unrecoverable: The maximum is released Area-2 questions, plus MA-Q-0172, plus one question for each distinct Area-2 decision family the exhaustive source census could defend. The census enumerated the source universe from official indexes and examined it to exhaustion: M.G.L. c. 13 ss. 22 to 25, M.G.L. c. 112 ss. 24 to 42D including s. 24B1/2 and s. 24B3/4, the whole of M.G.L. c. 94C, all 15 promulgated 247 CMR chapters, all 22 sections of 105 CMR 700.000, 243 CMR 2.12, and the Department of Public Health pharmacist-administration circular chain. Federal law is closed as an Area-2 vein by the bank's own taxonomy. Raising the ceiling would require authoring more than one question per distinct decision family, which breaches the saturated-family rule, or relabelling Area 1, Area 3 or Area 4 content as Area 2, which the controlling instruction forbids and which this census rejected on the record 43 times.

options_for_the_project_owner.controller_recommendation: Not recommended without an explicit written change to the rule, because it weakens a quality rule to make the plan pass.
